title: Gym Advertising Ideas to Pump Up Revenue at your Facility

facts.fact: The article was published on June 13, 2025.

The article presents 8 gym advertising tactics, including social media fitness challenges, loyalty programs, referral programs, influencer partnerships, local business partnerships, community events, fitness newsletters, and a fitness blog.
facts.quote: lay out 8 proven advertising tactics that will supercharge your fitness marketing strategy!

facts.fact: The article identifies millennial and Gen-Z customers as a key audience for modern gym advertising, saying people long for a full fitness experience.
facts.quote: People long for a full fitness experience, especially millennial and Gen-Z customers!

facts.fact: RhinoFit states that it offers a free mobile app for members to scan into the gym and sign up for classes.
facts.quote: we offer a [free mobile app](https://rhinofit.ca/software-features/freefitnessapp/) to make scanning into the gym

facts.fact: RhinoFit invites prospects to schedule a free demo of its gym management software.
